top_signals.title: SpaceX Debt for AI Chips to Hit Market as Soon as This Week
top_signals.summary: A portion of $40 billion in debt financing to pay for artificial intelligence chips for SpaceX may start being sold as soon as this week, with Goldman Sachs Group Inc. and Apollo Global Management Inc. serving as underwriters on the expected deal, according to a person with knowledge of the matter.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Homebuilder sentiment plunges to 14-year low, leading more builders to drop prices
top_signals.summary: Homebuilder sentiment fell to a 14-year low amid high mortgage rates and higher prices for energy, labor and materials. That caused more builder price cuts.

top_signals.title: Hydropower generation in the Southwest fell to record lows this summer
top_signals.summary: Prolonged drought conditions affecting the Colorado River Basin led to record low hydropower generation this summer in the Southwestern electricity supply region, which includes Arizona, New Mexico, and small parts of Nevada and California. Hydropower generation from April through August 2026 was 19% lower than during the same period last year and 28% lower than the 10-year average, according to the latest data from our Form EIA-923 survey
